name: Standard MCP Tool-Access Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent access to Model Context Protocol servers: only allowlisted tools may be called, per the capability parameters in the AIC.
author: varwof (open ecosystem)

capabilities.summary: Invoke only the tools the principal authorized on this MCP server
capabilities.usage: Agents that operate through an MCP server behind the gateway
capabilities.when_not: Dangerous tools (bash, delete, admin) must be excluded unless explicitly granted
